description: This PHP class defines the PerformanceTrackerReviewer entity within the OrangeHRM system. It models a reviewer for performance tracking, including properties such as reviewer, associated performance tracker, date added, and status. The class includes ORM annotations for database mapping and uses traits and decorators for additional behavior.

classes.name: PerformanceTrackerReviewer
classes.description: Entity class representing a reviewer in the performance tracking system, linked to a performance tracker and an employee reviewer, with metadata such as date added and status.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the unique identifier of the reviewer record.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the unique identifier of the reviewer record.

methods.name: getReviewer
methods.description: Retrieves the Employee who is the reviewer.

methods.name: setReviewer
methods.description: Sets the Employee as the reviewer.

methods.name: setPerformanceTracker
methods.description: Associates a PerformanceTracker with this reviewer.

methods.name: getAddedDate
methods.description: Gets the date when the review was added.

methods.name: setAddedDate
methods.description: Sets the date when the review was added.
